set.pl: Roth farm across the town line: N part of NE¼ NE¼ sec. 1 T7N R9E and into sec. 31 T8N R10E, with the house on the town-line road east of the golf links at Maple Bluff (c.1915 plat)
pinev: c.1915 Hixson Dane County plat (Madison and Burke sheets): the Roth farm runs east across the town line into sec. 31 T8N R10E, with a house mark on the town-line road; the 350 m circle covers the house site and the farm centre.

src: Hixson, Plat Book of Dane County, Wisconsin (c.1915), Burke sheet
